scope: pnpm audit --prod for the pnpm workspace (api, admin-web, buyer-web, seller-web, @teka/shared). Flutter apps are not workspace members and were not audited here.

ciGate.note: the 2 high are the two pre-existing pnpm.auditConfig.ignoreGhsas (GHSA-38f7-945m-qr2g, GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx, inside @prisma/config; docs/pre-scale-readiness.md), preserved byte-for-byte; no new exception added

whyNotFixed: @sentry/node@10.53.1 pins each instrumentation EXACTLY; forcing them across minors (e.g. pg 0.66 -> 0.73) via overrides would put versions in the Sentry SDK graph that it was not built or tested against — not done.

The inspected @sentry/node10.54.0 drops these package dependencies by vendoring them; official tarball source retains all six db.user assignments without a local sendDefaultPii guard. Audit-row disappearance alone is not evidence of a fix; no complete export-path fix was verified, so no upgrade was applied.

Official registry lists only10.53.0 and10.53.1 in the current patch line. Inspected10.76.2 still vendors unguarded DB_USER assignment for pg/mysql/mysql2/knex/tedious; no verified all-six fix. Mongoose has no such hit in10.76.2; absence alone is not a compatibility proof. No upgrade or incompatible instrumentation override applied.
residualDecision.exposure: The six adapters are installed/registered by Sentry but their driver modules are absent from the Node20 API image and three web application resolution paths; no affected database operation was demonstrated. Prisma uses its own engine. tracesSampleRate:0 drops local root traces but DOES NOT prohibit inherited sampled traces. Acceptance therefore relies on driver absence, not a blanket tracing-disabled claim.
residualDecision.approval: Explicit owner approval in this conversation on 2026-10-18; applies only to six moderate findings, not production release.
residualDecision.responsibleComponent: API and Buyer/Seller/Admin web Sentry telemetry integration; backend/web telemetry maintainer, with release owner responsible for acceptance review.
conditions: Do not add audit exceptions, suppress findings or weaken gates; existing two exceptions unchanged.
Reassess before adding any of the six drivers or changing telemetry/tracing configuration, even before the deadline.
Any demonstrated exploitable active production path is a release blocker regardless of severity; stop release work and remediate.
No Sentry11 or major refactoring without separate compatibility assessment and approval.
Review by2026-11-17; acceptance is not indefinite or a resolved finding.

followUp.tracking: This report and the focused-security section of docs/order-integrity-printing-app-promotion.md; six package-specific findings below share GHSA-qqmp-wf37-98f9 / CVE-2026-104872.
followUp.responsibleComponent: API and Buyer/Seller/Admin web Sentry telemetry integration; backend/web telemetry maintainer, with release owner responsible for acceptance review.
actions: Inspect a Sentry10.x release containing corrected vendored adapters; verify upstream source rather than audit disappearance alone.
Have Max-authenticated Opus implement only a demonstrated compatible fix; independently test API and all three web integrations, Node20 builds and privacy envelopes.
If no compatible upstream fix by deadline, reassess release risk and separately review targeted removal of unused instrumentations or a data-minimization change; do not silently extend acceptance.
remediationOptions: Compatible Sentry10.x release with verified adapter fix and integration validation.
Separately scoped disabling/removal of unused affected integrations.
Separately reviewed span attribute filtering if an affected driver becomes necessary; no unsupported OTel override.

independentRuntimeEvidence.probe_correction: First probe used SQL alias identical to synthetic DB username, creating a false-positive string match. Query alias corrected; shipping configuration unchanged.
independentRuntimeEvidence.transport: in-memory only; no Sentry request sent
independentRuntimeEvidence.claimLimit: Zero local sample rate does not imply tracing is globally disabled: incoming sampled parents may be inherited. Six advisory driver modules are absent.

residualDecision.productionVerificationLimit: Compared committed last-deployed60d70ac configuration and current artifacts; no live VPS environment, production database or actual Sentry account telemetry was read. Synthetic in-memory probes establish local behavior only. No real telemetry sent.

sentry10Investigation.conclusion: No verified safe all-six fix identified; keep10.53.1 and time-limited acceptance visible.

proxyTrustReview.topology: docker-compose.prod.yml: only nginx publishes ports (80/443); api has no ports and sits on the internal frontend/backend networks. nginx.prod.conf restores the visitor IP from CF-Connecting-IP for Cloudflare CIDRs only (real_ip_recursive on) and forwards X-Forwarded-For: $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for (verified $remote_addr appended rightmost). docker-compose.yml (local dev) publishes 5050 on the host: dev only.
proxyTrustReview.identityConsumers: ThrottlerGuard.getTracker -> req.ip; @Ip() (password reset, contact form) -> req.ip; AuthController.extractDevice -> req.ip (RefreshToken.ipAddress). OTP/login/reset budgets are also keyed on phone/email (RateLimitService).
proxyTrustReview.limitation: Numeric trust 1 trusts the direct peer BY POSITION, not by address. Any process able to connect to api:5050 directly (e.g. another container on the frontend network, or a future published port) can choose its own req.ip. The boundary is the network topology, which was not changed.
proxyTrustReview.tests: apps/api/test/proxy-trust.e2e-spec.ts (32 tests, PASS): trust value parsed from main.ts source; real Express/proxy-addr resolved through @nestjs/platform-express over raw loopback HTTP; spoofed prefixes, duplicate XFF lines, X-Real-IP/CF-Connecting-IP/True-Client-IP/Forwarded ignored, no-trust ignores XFF, IPv6/IPv4-mapped clients and peers (IPv6 cases skip only if no ::1 loopback), position-not-address limitation pinned, 4 GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h vectors + 4 legitimate subnets, real Nest ThrottlerGuard not bypassable by rotating prefixes, no-trust shares one socket bucket, @Ip and login session metadata store the rightmost client, OTP budget stays phone-keyed. External sends (email, PostHog, WhatsApp) stubbed by spies.

No other version changed.

findings.title: proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet
findings.runtimeAssessment: API runtime: loaded on every request for req.ip / req.ips. Vulnerable code path (IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust SUBNET with prefix <96) is only reached when trust proxy is an address list; main.ts ships the NUMBER 1 (positional), so the reviewed numeric policy does not exercise the affected subnet-matching path; live production configuration was not inspected. Patched anyway; regression vectors that were true on 2.0.7 (verified locally pre-upgrade) are now pinned false in apps/api/test/proxy-trust.e2e-spec.ts.
findings.compatibilityImpact: Same2.0 patch; corrects malformed IPv4-mapped IPv6 subnet matching. Reviewed numeric one-hop policy is unchanged; live production configuration was not inspected.
findings.validationRequirementsAndCurrentEvidence: 32 real Express/Nest proxy regressions; IPv4/IPv6/mapped, duplicate/spoofed headers, identity budgets, session/reset IP metadata; Node20 image subnet and HTTP checks passed.

findings.title: @fastify/busboy vulnerable to Denial of Service via oversized multipart boundary
findings.runtimeAssessment: API runtime, lazily: firebase-admin/lib/utils/api-request.js requires it only to parse multipart RESPONSES from Google APIs (TLS, trusted upstream); never parses client uploads (those go through multer/busboy 1.x). Fixed (2 high + 1 moderate).
findings.compatibilityImpact: Same3.2 patch; malformed multipart response headers may now be refused. Client uploads use separate busboy1.x via multer.
findings.validationRequirementsAndCurrentEvidence: Full API multipart/upload/auth suites plus Node20 Firebase multipart-parser integration passed.

findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js: In certain configurations, getAuthContext can return unauthorized certificates as though they were authorized
findings.runtimeAssessment: Installed in API production image but NOT loaded on the used path: the API only calls admin.messaging() (push.service.ts); Firestore (and thus gax/grpc) is required lazily by firebase-admin only via admin.firestore(), which the code never calls. API is a gRPC client only, never a gRPC server. Fixed.
findings.compatibilityImpact: Same1.14 patch; affects TLS-auth-context handling. Teka sends Firebase messaging requests and does not run a gRPC TLS server.
findings.validationRequirementsAndCurrentEvidence: Node20 Firebase Messaging/Firestore construction passed with networking disabled; no live Google RPC, mTLS peer, credentials or message tested.

findings.title: Multiple @opentelemetry/instrumentation-* packages expose database username via unconditional db.user span attribute
findings.dependency: transitive (exact pins in @sentry/node@10.53.1; also via @sentry/nextjs@10.53.1 in the web apps)
findings.runtimeAssessment: The six adapters are installed/registered by Sentry but their driver modules are absent from the Node20 API image and three web application resolution paths; no affected database operation was demonstrated. Prisma uses its own engine. tracesSampleRate:0 drops local root traces but DOES NOT prohibit inherited sampled traces. Acceptance therefore relies on driver absence, not a blanket tracing-disabled claim. Potential impact if introduced: database username/service-account disclosure through db.user telemetry. No credentials or bound query values found in isolated Prisma envelopes; live production telemetry uninspected.
findings.compatibilityImpact: Unchanged pinned OpenTelemetry adapter; forcing cross-minor versions is not accepted as safe under the current Sentry graph.
findings.validationRequirementsAndCurrentEvidence: Node20 shipping API bootstrap with in-memory Sentry transport, actual isolated Prisma queries incl bound values and incoming sampled parent; web shipping Node configs also capture/scrub errors. Six drivers absent. Configuration byte-identical to last recorded deployed60d70ac. See residualDecision.
findings.responsibleComponent: API and Buyer/Seller/Admin web Sentry telemetry integration; backend/web telemetry maintainer, with release owner responsible for acceptance review.
findings.riskJustification: No installed matching driver/active affected operation in reviewed artifacts; user-approved temporary acceptance, conditioned on no active exploitable production path. Not resolved or suppressed.
